title: Dependabot
description: The configuration of Dependabot version updates: which package managers, in which folders, how often.

directory.description: The folder of the manifests, from the root of the repository ("/").

directories.description: Several folders of manifests (glob patterns allowed).

schedule.description: How often Dependabot looks for new versions.

day.description: The day of a weekly check.

time.description: The time of the check, hh:mm (UTC unless timezone says).

timezone.description: The time zone of time: Europe/Paris…

cronjob.description: When, in cron syntax, with the cron interval.

target-branch.description: The branch the pull requests are opened against (the default branch otherwise).

open-pull-requests-limit.description: The most pull requests open at a time (5 by default; 0 stops version updates).

labels.description: The labels of the pull requests.

assignees.description: The people the pull requests are assigned to.

milestone.description: The number of the milestone of the pull requests.

ignore.description: Dependencies or versions to leave as they are.

dependency-name.description: The name of the dependency (* for any part).

update-types.description: The kinds of updates to leave out.

dependency-name.description: The name of the dependency (* for any part).

groups.description: Updates gathered in one pull request per group.

applies-to.description: The updates the group is for.

dependency-type.description: The kind of dependencies of the group.

patterns.description: The dependencies of the group (* for any part).

exclude-patterns.description: The dependencies left out of the group.

update-types.description: The kinds of updates of the group.

commit-message.description: How the commit messages and titles start.

prefix.description: The start of the messages (chore, build(deps)…).

prefix-development.description: The start of the messages of development dependencies.

include.description: scope adds deps or deps-dev after the prefix.

rebase-strategy.description: Whether Dependabot rebases its pull requests when they conflict.

versioning-strategy.description: How the version requirements of the manifest change.

registries.description: The private registries this update may use, by name, or *.

insecure-external-code-execution.description: Whether the code of the manifests may run during the update.

separator.description: The separator of the branch names.

cooldown.description: Days to wait after a release before updating to it.

exclude.description: The dependencies it is not for.

updates.description: The package managers to update, each with its folder and its schedule.

registries.description: Private registries, by name, with their type, address and credentials (secrets).

enable-beta-ecosystems.description: Allow the package managers still in beta.

multi-ecosystem-groups.description: Groups of updates across package managers.
